correctness.rationale: A quintic with zero affine first jets at all seven points restricts to zero on each line (three double roots exceed degree five). All seven distinct lines would divide it, so it must be zero. Equal source and target dimensions give the jet isomorphism; Euler identifies its nonzero transverse gradients with the three incident tangents. A triple fiber forces a line component by the same degree bound; a reducible divisor or a repeated component is geometrically singular. Independently I enumerated all 16,384 coefficient masks vanishing at the seven points, by matching evaluation syndromes of two monomial blocks, and evaluated the homogeneous partial derivatives. Exactly 2,187 forms have seven nonzero gradients with distinct tangent maps. The incidence-preserving permutations of the Fano plane give 168 automorphisms; the 18 map orbits have the same sizes and profiles as claimed. Unit-ideal checks over F2 on the charts of representatives establish absence of gradient zeros over the algebraic closure, since Euler makes a gradient zero a point of the curve. There are 3, 6 and 1 qualifying orbits carrying 420, 924 and 168 assignments, respectively. The rejected assignments consist of 24 bijections, 84 concurrent triple-double maps and 567 maps with a triple fiber. The criterion excludes exactly these cases, whose singularities must be nonrational by construction.
residual_risks: The finite theorem concerns embedded degree-five forms over F2 only; it is not a multi-field theorem or an abstract curve-isomorphism count.

evidence: The pencil table encodes 108 representative pencils with 197 distinct member masks. I evaluated their gradients at the seven binary points and expanded each tangent-map orbit under the 168 projectivities. The resulting union has 1,512 maps and ten orbits. Breakdown: three orbits of sizes 84,168,168 have profile (2,1,1,1,1,1); six of sizes 84,168,168,168,168,168 have (2,2,1,1,1); one size-168 orbit has (2,2,2,1) with nonconcurrent doubles. Thus the smooth membership is actually recoverable from an inspected table, not conjecturally stored somewhere.
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: Every pencil member in these data is geometrically smooth, orbit expansion preserves smoothness, and the 1,512 distinct maps already equal the census total. No extra smooth classes are assumed and no abstract-to-embedded lift is needed.

originality.rationale: Although the inspected related findings do not state the concise fiber criterion, it is already a mechanical corollary of exact indexed data. A distinct same-date pencil record contains the full first-jet rank and a published table whose smooth member forms exhaust the ten smooth orbits. Computing seven gradients per listed form and tallying incident maps recovers the entire iff without any new geometric-smoothness test. This is checked coverage in the indexed corpus, not a determination of historical priority between same-date records.
residual_risks: No order or provenance is inferred from the matching record having the same date; the verdict rests on mathematical coverage.
The exact reach of Huang–Kedlaya–Lau's pre-isomorphism files is not needed for the established implication from the indexed pencil data.

value.rationale: A local-data rule that avoids evaluating projective gradient ideals on a new input is a useful description. In this package, however, the precise rule is obtained by tallying the already available exact smooth census and matching its orbit profiles with incidence, not by discovering a separate mechanism for the concurrency obstruction or extending the theorem. That table recoding does not establish a distinct valuable remainder for repair under the review standard.
residual_risks: A conceptual proof not dependent on the census, or an extension to other degrees/fields, is not assessed or claimed here.
